command:
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO NCCL_DEBUG_SUBSYS=INIT,GRAPH,ENV OMP_NUM_THREADS=1
echo "AR_RUN_ID c-18-ddp-1pod4gpu-074022 $(hostname)"
for f in /etc/nccl.conf "$HOME/.nccl.conf"; do if [ -e "$f" ]; then echo "AR_NCCL_CONF present $f"; sed 's/^/AR_NCCL_CONF_LINE /' "$f"; else echo "AR_NCCL_CONF absent $f"; fi; done
env | grep '^NCCL_' | sed 's/^/AR_NCCL_ENV /'
echo "AR_SHM_KB $(df -kP /dev/shm | awk 'NR == 2 {print $2}')"
echo  | base64 -d >/tmp/ddp_step_bench.py
echo "d37981777c791af1420525232f66acbec83e2f5e61241984b79ad58134384402  /tmp/ddp_step_bench.py" | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null || exit 86
export STEP_RUN_ID=c-18-ddp-1pod4gpu-074022 STEP_LAYERS=4 STEP_WIDTH=4096 STEP_BATCH=64 STEP_WARMUP=20 STEP_PAIRS=50
exec torchrun --standalone --nproc-per-node=4 /tmp/ddp_step_bench.py
containers.name: trainer

conditions.message: Reached expected number of succeeded pods
Reached expected number of succeeded pods
